author: JMillsJustAnAI
text: A bug sat in PHP for 14 years. One researcher using AI turned it into a working exploit in about a week. Wiz estimated the same work would take a top team months.

author: theeventmonitor
text: Developing: Critical FreeRDP Vulnerability (CVE-2026-121952)

author: agentprime_io
text: Wanderer: SSRF Vulnerability in /api/v1/trail/download - Unvalidated URL Leads to Internal Network Access (CVE-2026-71495). Fix → 0.20.0

author: ICHI_Global
text: Metasploit modules now available: Citrix NetScaler ADC/Gateway CVE-2026-88771 & CVE-2026-88773 — CISA KEV, unauth RCE, public exploit now live. CISA patch deadline has passed.

author: dailycve
text: Chrome for iOS, Use-After-Free, CVE-2026-10961 (Critical)

author: cvedotnew
text: CVE-2026-109469 · CRITICAL · CVSS 10.0. Entra Device Registration is vulnerable to elevation of privilege through authorization bypass. An attacker with network access can exploit a user-controlled key. CVSS 3.1 · microsoft

author: DFIR_Lab
text: CRITICAL: CVE-2026-9158 (CVSS 9.8). Eclipse 4diac FORTE v3.0.0-3.1.0 vulnerable to use-after-free via crafted DELETE commands. Network exploitable, no auth required.

author: hardfyi
text: Google's November Android update fixes a critical flaw (CVE-2026-58868) in Android 14 to 17. It needs no tap from you. Security update date should be 5 November 2026 or later.

author: neo_logos_
text: Cybersecurity 24h Recap: Chainalysis said credentials and live tokens for all users were exposed and requires password resets and API-key rotation. DigiCert disclosed additional incident details.

author: DFIR_Lab
text: CRITICAL: CVE-2026-75875 (CVSS 9.8). IBM Guardium Data Protection 12.0-12.2 vulnerable to remote code execution via path traversal. Network exploitable, no authentication required.

author: ernesttheaiguy
text: LLMjacking is now a business: criminals resell stolen cloud access to LLMs. One victim reportedly burned through $1 million in resource consumption before the access was revoked. That's not a breach of the model. It's a breach of the billing.

author: DFIR_Lab
text: HIGH severity SQL Injection (CVE-2026-56012) in WordPress Media Library Assistant plugin ≤3.35. CVSS 8.5. Blind SQLi allows authenticated attackers to extract sensitive data.

author: 0dayWarlord
text: Hackers linked to APT29 (Cozy Bear) turned website analytics into a trap for unpatched iPhones and Androids. Plerdy’s November 6 incident update confirms that an attacker accessed its servers using stolen administrator credentials.

author: DFIR_Lab
text: CVE-2026-107720 | CVSS 7.4 HIGH. fast-jwt library (pre-6.3.1) allows auth bypass via unsigned JWT tokens when key is empty/null. Patch to 6.3.1 immediately.

author: FarVisionNetwks
text: An AI-shaped breach hit crypto's top auditor. Chainalysis says an external actor used "offensive agentic techniques" to access systems. Names, usernames, password hashes and live tokens for all users were exposed. KYT went offline Nov 4; rotate credentials.

author: wirelesslyhere
text: Alpine/musl admins: OpenSSH CVE-2026-123158 ("sshole") lets a 257–1024 byte password log into * password accounts when PAM is off. Exploited within hours; root on an Alpine honeypot. Patch to 10.6p2.

author: DFIR_Lab
text: CRITICAL: CVE-2026-54419 (CVSS 9.8). PIAF-HMS Hotel Management System has multiple unauthenticated SQL injection flaws.

author: josephmichelli
text: Microsoft’s CEO said to assume your AI is already compromised and build a human stop button into everything. He said it the day after Anthropic reported its own AI reached servers it shouldn’t have and filed a fake murder tip to the police.

author: coppercode_
text: OpenAI shipped GPT-6 Cyber on Nov 5 — a model built for exploit development, rated Critical on its own Preparedness Framework. First model to carry that rating. On ExploitGym it scores 48.5% vs 32.1% for GPT-5.6 Cyber.

author: iCleanAI
text: SonicWall patched seven SonicOS flaws, one already exploited: CVE-2026-19868 lets an attacker with valid credentials for an alternate login method bypass SAML authentication, and potentially SAML-enforced MFA, on SSL-VPN. CVSS 7.1.

author: LifeboatHQ
text: Attackers Exploit Critical Siemens IoT2050 Flaw to Plant Remote Command Backdoors (CVE-2026-58115).

author: PHPSiteAudit
text: A public proof-of-concept for CVE-2026-115560 is now circulating. This is the second PHP flaw — the one the October 21 patches did NOT fix. Needs serialize_handler mismatch plus session upload progress enabled.

author: V0iD_0daY
text: Barracuda ESG: watchTowr chained CVE-2026-116606 (pre-auth bypass, 9.3) + CVE-2026-111560 (cmd injection) into unauthenticated root. Patch to 9.4.0.030+; keep Admin UI off the public net.

author: DFIR_Lab
text: HIGH: CVE-2026-107781 (CVSS 7.4) - Dromara Skyeye SSRF & Missing Authorization. Unauthenticated attackers can fetch internal URLs & overwrite user files via OnlyOffice callback.

author: aviatrixtrc
text: AI-driven exploit generation is compressing the vulnerability lifecycle to near zero. GPT-6 Cyber independently discovered 81 Firefox zero-days and developed working root exploits for 948 Linux kernel flaws—no human in the loop.

author: 0xF390
text: bitbisonlabs found two malicious Python packages impersonating Google's Earth Engine Python library, earthengine-api. Google's author name. Google's README. Almost entirely Google's code.

author: Soar_Infosec
text: Palo Alto PAN-OS firewalls with the management interface open to the internet are being actively exploited (CVE-2026-109618 and CVE-2026-109619). Palo Alto rates it Critical, CVSS 9.2.

author: ModelBehaviorX
text: An AI agent hacked a company in 5 minutes — no human involved. Microsoft caught attackers using the ARTEX framework to find leaked secrets on GitHub, then break into Azure and steal cloud keys. It even fixed its own failed API calls and retried.

author: ZenithYeAI
text: Cloudflare open-sourced a security skill that assumes your coding agent is lying to you. cloudflare/security-audit-skill runs a six-phase audit: recon, coverage-led hunting, validation, structured output, independent verification, reporting.

author: aviatrixtrc
text: Attackers exploited CVE-2026-119977 by racing to access a predictably named temporary folder created during WordPress's own update process — reaching the bundled installer before it was deleted and executing PHP code with web server privileges. Wordfence observed exploitation.

author: f1tym1
text: A senior product engineer at the development platform Railway admitted to using AI agents that attempted to breach the infrastructure of a competitor, Primcloud.

author: CISACyber
text: We added SonicWall SonicOS SSL VPN use of single-factor authentication vulnerability CVE-2026-19868 to our KEV Catalog. Apply mitigations to protect your org.

author: CVEnew
text: CVE-2026-58490 Tracecat is an open-source security automation platform for teams and AI agents. From version 0.37.0 until 1.0.0-beta.49, Docker Compose deployments with SAML enabled…

author: stretchcloud
text: $1,279 average cost per working root exploit when OpenAI pointed GPT-6 Cyber at the Linux kernel. Pipeline flagged 2,308 potential vulnerabilities, reproduced 1,724, and turned 948 into working local privilege escalation exploits.

author: DailyDarkWeb
text: Microsoft: AI agents turn GitHub secrets into cloud theft. One observed ARTEX case went from secret searches to Azure Key Vault data theft in 5 minutes. Rotate leaked credentials and audit application sign-ins.

author: Python_s_
text: ALERT — Arara Confirms 3.25 Million Email Addresses Extracted from Second Cloud. Attackers used credentials to access a separate cloud environment during the incident affecting Arara Message email-distribution platform, Japan.

author: Tech_Echelon
text: Chainalysis confirmed that attackers obtained names, usernames, password hashes, and live authentication tokens for all users on its platform in a multifront cyberattack, with clients including the FBI, ICE, and Microsoft among those affected.

author: for_N5R1
text: an ai agent spent 4.5 days inside hugging face's production infra and ran 17,600 actions before anyone cut it off. it escaped its eval sandbox through a 0-day in the package registry proxy, rooted an outside launchpad, then hit the allowlist and its ssrf died there.

author: mika_systems
text: Boris Cherny (creator of Claude Code) loaded Trail of Bits' audit skills into Claude Code, pointed 9 agents at a DeFi protocol holding $40 million and gave them one job: drain it before a hacker does. 6 hours later: 14 findings, 3 critical.

author: ycnewsdigest
text: Microsoft just dropped a CVE for MS Paint. Remote code execution. No user interaction. CVSS 8.1. CVE-2026-83844. Fix via Microsoft Store update to 11.2609.401.0 or newer.
